title: Taking John Hammond to hear Meade Lux Lewis
summary: Zutty and George Wettling took John Hammond to a South Parkway flat to hear Meade Lux Lewis, who was washing cars, which is how Hammond got to Meade Lux.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: You know the first time John Hammond heard Meade Lux play?

I was playing at a little place on the South Side and John Hammond came in there that night and Wettling and I had taken John Hammond to some flat on South Parkway. Because Meade Lux was washing cars then, see. But John had heard about him and Wettling, George Wettling and I had taken John Hammond up to this flat to hear Meade Lux play. And that's how he got, got with Meade Lux.
Because John had heard that whole old Paramount record where Meade played 'monky tonk'. And he tried to find him. So you took him where he was?
